S50U26.today_summary: 1057.8 closed -12.7 (-1.19%), the first settlement below the 1070 max pain that has not moved in ten sessions. Total net dealer gamma swung 9,346 points in one day, +2,027 to -7,319, leaving cumulative GEX negative at every strike from 990 to 1150 and no flip on the board at all. 826 lots at the 1050 put built OI +439 to 2,408 and lifted its IV 12.91% to 14.22% - the largest single-strike print in the chain and the first fully Vol2Vol-confirmed wall of the window. ATM IV made a window high at 13.54% on 5,545 total lots against 3,039 yesterday, widening the 1-sigma day 8.62 to 9.02 points.
what_changed: Total net GEX crossed zero, +2,027 to -7,319, the first negative print in the seven-session window and a 9,346-point swing in one session.
Spot closed -12.7 at 1057.8, 12.2 points below a 1070 max pain that has not moved a strike since 09-09 - price fell through the anchor rather than the anchor moving to price.
1050 put OI built +439 to 2,408 on 826 lots with IV up 1.31 points to 14.22%, and 1040 added +381 on 556 lots - real downside hedging, not the 0.2-point tail tickets bought on 09-16.
Call OI broke a four-session drain and added +541 to 19,138, concentrated +208 at 1070 and +118 at 1060 as those strikes flipped from at-the-money to overhead supply.
S50U26.five_day_thesis: Net dealer GEX has traveled +11,678 on 09-09 to -7,319 today - an 18,997-point collapse straight through zero, with every intermediate print (10,779, 11,138, 5,733, 3,080, 2,027) a one-way drain and no session of rebuild. Max pain 1070, the 1100 call wall and the structural 910 put wall have not moved a single strike in seven sessions, so nothing migrated: the gamma underneath the levels inverted while the levels stood still, and today price finally broke through them. The flip walked 1090 to 1100 and is now off the top of the 1150 chain, so spot that sat 92 points above the flip in dealer long gamma on 09-09 is below a flip that no longer prints on the board. Put OI added 1,815 contracts across the window to 45,612 while call OI is net -211, but today inverted that pattern too - calls added 541 into the decline while the 1050/1040 puts took +820 on 1,382 lots. ATM IV bottomed at 12.21% on 09-11 and has now made a window high of 13.54%, the first session where IV expansion and an 82% volume jump confirm the break instead of contradicting it.

S50U26.risk_note: Educational analysis only - not trade advice, and no position sizing is implied. SET50 options are cash-settled on the SET50 index with no physical delivery, so the dealer-hedging mechanics behind pinning are structurally weaker here than for share-settled single stocks: treat max pain 1070 as a tendency, not a magnet, and note that today price already traded 12.2 points through it on confirming volume and IV. Defined-risk is not risk-free - the capped max loss on every structure above is a real outcome, and macro or news flow can override the option structure outright.

S50Z26.five_day_thesis: Only two sessions exist for this series (listed 09-16), so this is a one-day delta rather than a five-day thesis - history will fill in over the coming week. What the single delta shows is a board being built, not a board exerting force: OI +10.9% to 5,809 on 4.7x volume, max pain and the 1100 call wall unchanged, and the 960 put wall growing +75 contracts in the tail. The one directional tell is pricing rather than positioning - the 1010 put marked 13.52% to 12.64% and the 10-delta tail flattened +1.54 to -0.06 while spot fell 11.9 points, so this series richened the call side into a decline. With 5,809 contracts against the front series' 64,750, S50Z26 is 8% of the total burden map and has no level of its own to defend. Track whether the 1060 put keeps building - that is the strike that would first give this series a live near-money wall.
